items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: A great arranger, great trumpet player with Woody Herman

ctx.x: A great arranger, great trumpet player with Woody Herman, Berklee School of Music, New England, MIT. Greg Caputo’s good friend, that’s where I met Greg. Contractor. Great trumpet player. And Everett — I owe Everett a lot. He’s re-done a lot of the arrangements and things. And he says, “You never yell at a guy, you just don’t call them anymore.” You know so and if you walked on my bandstand and you’re 15 minutes late, “Oh man I’m really sorry I’m late man, you won’t believe what — ” I don’t want to hear. If you’re…
loose. It wasn’t like, hey man, you know. As soon as it started getting a little too relaxed he’d pull it together.
